The '''''Light of Truth''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that was conscripted into the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] following the dissolution of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]]. In [[990 BBY]], a [[message drone]] was sent to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] informing them of a grievously injured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. A [[Ambria strike team|team]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tho'natu]], flew in the ''Light of Truth'' to Ambria in order to arrest this being. There, they were abruptly [[Confrontation on Ambria|attacked]] by a [[Summon fear|maddened]] [[Darovit]], who they quickly killed. Believing that the Sith were completely destroyed, the Jedi left the planet aboard the Jedi cruiser, taking with them the decimated corpse of the [[Force healing/Legends|healer]], [[Caleb]], whom they mistakenly believed had sent the message. This allowed for the survival of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], who had arranged the ploy in order to save her [[Sith Master/Legends|master's]] life and erase all knowledge of the existence of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
